steps.comment: ===== REQUIRED anchor: the record number keys every downstream record. If Accela renames this label id, `require(...)` fails the run `selector_miss` (with the failing page's HTML banked by captureOnFailure) — NOT a page of empty records. Drop the require() to make it soft.=====

===== SOFT optional fields: a miss degrades to '' AND increments stats.selectorMisses / emits a SelectorMiss event, so a drifting county is visible to #47 drift monitoring while the run still succeeds. A matched-but-empty field is '' too but is NOT a miss. To make ALL of these terminal without per-field require(), set config.strictExtraction: true. =====

result: { recordNumber: recordNumber, recordType: recordType, status: status, openedOn: openedOn }
